aboutStory.heroTitle: Crafted for Soft Mornings & Barefoot Adventures
aboutStory.subtitle: From delicate smocking to heirloom cotton stitches, we believe childhood clothes should feel like a gentle hug.
paragraphs: The Sewing Bird creates thoughtful children's clothing that bridges the charm of vintage heirlooms with the carefree ease of modern play.

Every dress, romper, and co-ord set is cut from premium organic cotton, airy double gauze, and washed linens. We obsess over the quiet details—flat-felled French seams that never scratch tender skin, coconut shell buttons, and soft elastic bands that allow curious minds to climb, twirl, and explore unhindered.

values.title: 100% Breathable Organic Cotton
values.description: Naturally hypoallergenic, skin-kind, and pre-washed for zero shrinkage and butter-soft touch.

values.title: Heirloom Handcrafting
values.description: Tender hand-smocking, reinforced knees, and French seams designed to be passed down through siblings.

values.title: Play-Tested Comfort
values.description: Generous cuts that accommodate diapers and dynamic movement without pinch points.

values.title: Conscious & Sustainable
values.description: Zero plastic packaging, plant-based dyes, and zero-waste fabric offcut recycling.
